en: You don't really feel like getting up...
Time to get up! Another day again. Another day of work...
You crawl out of bed and get ready for work.
You have the feeling maybe your phone rang at some point...
This thing stops working as soon as you need it. It's been like this so long you forget what it's like not to have to argue with your office supplies.
You actually have work to do. Someone else can take care of this if they want to.
You check the error message and do a quick search for causes.
It takes a relative age. When it's done running updates, The printer starts working down the list of documents in queue.
You can't believe no one thought to do this before.
Apparently your coworkers can't either. There's an embarrassed silence while everyone looks on as the printer busily works away.
Then, there's a bit of a stir as people get to cancelling old tickets and the usual office noises start back up again.
Where do you think you are going!
I might be late if i get some coffee. Should i do it?
You enter the market to get a nice, hot, delicious coffee.
The mashine roars to life and starts to prepares a perfect cup of black gold.
Meh. Better then nothing i guess.
At first the nmashine produces smal droplets. But they swell to a steady stream of steaming coffee.

The mashine sprays out the last cloud of aromatic vapours and returns to its motionles dead state.
The coffe in the cup shimmers like a kalm dark pond in the middle of a forrest.
Pure extasy.
One coffee is enouth for now. I should hurry to work.
I should just head to work.
Good morning! Cutting it a bit close, aren't we?
Well don't just stand there gawking!
A old Lady blocks your way. Passing by is just not possible.

Large bags are lying on the floor. Food and products are everywhere.
A massacre of Produce.
Realy. What should i do now.
You push her to the side.
Out of my way old hag.
Oh that is very nice of you!
You pick up the items on the floor, and put them back in the bags.
You are such a nice person. You do not meet them very often nowadays.
Not at all. Happy to help.
Big tears roll from her eyes. Sobbing and crying in the middle of her bags and groceries.
You walk on filled with anger.
Nothing you can do other than wait.
Your desk looks as uninspiring as always.
Stay standing in front of your desk.
Please go stand at your own desk.
You stare at him until he looks at you.
You stare at each other awkwardly.
Your colleague looks taken aback for a moment, then he turns away from you.
A dog is lying on the ground in front of the supermarket.
You ignore the dog. So does the dog.
You wonder why this dog sits here.
No sight of anyone caring for the dog.
It may have been a long time since someone realy noticed the poor thing.
It sits here day in day out. Is it waiting for something?
You slowly get closer to the dog. Finaly you put forth you hand and offer your empty hand to the dog.
The dog looks at you hand. After some hesitation, it sniffs your hand.
Did you finish your report? I want it tomorrow morning on my desk!
I'm not paying you to chit-chat!
Is that attitude you're giving me?
I fixed that problem we'd been having with the printer.
Oh? Well, good job! About time!
You are not putting in the work I expect of you. You keep coming in late and your work mentality lately is abysmal!
Show some spite! Put in some effort!
If you allow yourself one more plunder, that's it!
Now that's more like it. Keep it up!

The coffee mashine looks like a christmas tree.
Lights blinking constantly.
Realy? Someone has to do something about this!
